definitions.gloss: strikeout; being called out on three strikes
definitions.explanation: in baseball, when a batter accumulates three strikes and is out

examples.japanese: {三振|さんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{見逃|みのが}し→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧{三振|さんしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
⟦ピッチャー→ピッチャー：09482_picchaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧10⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三振|さんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}った→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。

notes:
BASEBALL TERM:
{三振|さんしん} combines ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ (three) + {振|しん} (swing). It refers to accumulating three strikes.

TYPES OF STRIKEOUTS:
- ⟦{空振|からぶ}り→空振り：08587_karaburi⟧{三振|さんしん} - swinging strikeout
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}し→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧{三振|さんしん} - called strikeout (looking)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三振|さんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧/⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧ - to strike out (as pitcher)
- {三振|さんしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧ - to strike out (as batter)
- {三振|さんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧ - to suffer a strikeout

STATISTICS:
- {奪|うば}{三振|さんしん} - strikeouts (pitcher stat)
- {三振率|さんしんりつ} - strikeout rate

SCOREKEEPING:
In Japanese scorekeeping, K is used for strikeouts as in English.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{空振|からぶ}り→空振り：08587_karaburi⟧ - swing and miss
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}し→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧ - called strike
- {四球|しきゅう} - walk (base on balls)
